brief: Compare vehicle finance offers including deposits, instalments and final balloon payments.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Financing Totals"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Totales al financiar vehículo"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Totais ao financiar veículo"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare vehicle finance offers including deposits, instalments and final balloon payments.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Small instalments can hide a large final payment; compare fictional dollars across the whole contract.
instruction.misconception: The offer with the lowest monthly instalment is the cheapest regardless of deposit, duration and final payment.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Total the deposit, all instalments and any final balloon. Compare equal ownership outcomes and check fees separately.
The final payment counts beyond the regular instalments.
Regular instalments do not include a separately stated final payment.
Include deposit, every instalment and the additional final amount.
Different ownership outcomes need explicit treatment in the comparison.
Affordable instalments do not fund the additional final obligation.
Smaller instalments do not guarantee a smaller total.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
